_readme: Target chains for ShelterSplit. Chain IDs and USDC addresses were checked on 2026-09-25 against the linked official docs. RPC URLs are never stored here: each network names the env var that holds its RPC URL. verify: true means the value still needs a human check before mainnet. splitTokens lists optional second payout tokens per network (EURC, checked 2026-09-29): `fund a:wave --token EURC` deploys a separate ShelterSplit instance for it.

mainnet.notes: USDC is also the native gas token (18 decimals natively; the ERC-20 interface at 0x3600... uses 6). Explorer path pattern assumed Blockscout-style. 2026-10-02 testnet run: Foundry's local EVM cannot emulate the USDC system contract at 0x3600... (StackUnderflow), so forge-script proof payouts fail in simulation; proofVia cast sends addShelter/approve/disburse to the real node instead.

EURC.notes: Same address on the Arc contract-addresses page and the Circle EURC page. 6 decimals.

verifier.note: Arc docs show blockscout for testnet; mainnet endpoint assumed by analogy

mainnet.notes: Checked 2026-10-03: chain ID 4663, gas token ETH, public RPC and explorer from https://docs.robinhood.com/chain/connecting. No USDC on Robinhood Chain: the payout token is USDG (Paxos Global Dollar) at 0x5fc5360D0400a0Fd4f2af552ADD042D716F1d168, 6 decimals, from https://docs.paxos.com/guides/stablecoin/usdg/mainnet; symbol() and decimals() were read on-chain with cast on 2026-10-03. Payouts are USDG, never summed with USDC. Source verification goes through Sourcify (lists chain 4663): robinhoodchain.blockscout.com/api returns a Cloudflare 403 to forge (checked 2026-10-03).

testnet.name: Robinhood Chain Testnet
testnet.notes: Checked 2026-10-03: testnet 46630 has no official stablecoin (docs.robinhood.com/chain/connecting). Public RPC https://rpc.testnet.chain.robinhood.com (eth_chainId 46630 checked 2026-10-03). Gas token is testnet ETH. The explorer is Blockscout (its /api answered eth_block_number on 2026-10-03). Payout token is the mockToken below: TESTNET ONLY.

mockToken.notes: No stablecoin exists on Robinhood Chain testnet, so `fund a:wave --network testnet` deploys the test MockUSDC (name "Mock USDC", symbol mUSDC, 6 decimals, anyone can mint) in the same broadcast as ShelterSplit (DeployShelterSplit.s.sol SHELTERSPLIT_MOCK_TOKEN=1) and mints PROOF_AMOUNT to the deployer. fund a:ingest records that instance with mock: true and tokenAddress. Not a real dollar. A mockToken on any mainnet entry is refused by wave.mjs, and the Solidity script reverts MockTokenOnTestnetOnly outside the testnet chain-id list. Mainnet (4663) pays real USDG.

mainnet.notes: Checked 2026-09-27. Chain ID, explorer and public keyless RPC (https://rpc.tempo.xyz) from the connection-details page. usdc is USDC.e (Bridged USDC, Stargate; no native Circle USDC on Tempo) from https://tempo.xyz/developers/docs/guide/bridge-layerzero; TIP-20 decimals are always 6 (TIP-20 spec). No native gas token: fees are paid in a TIP-20 stablecoin (pathUSD 0x20c0000000000000000000000000000000000000 is the fallback fee token), so the deployer needs pathUSD or USDC.e, and forge needs a Tempo-aware Foundry (foundryup; --tempo.fee-token). verify: the /tx/ explorer path is assumed (only /address/ was seen), and T6 receive policies can silently redirect a shelter's share to ReceivePolicyGuard (see applications/colosseum-worlds-fair/notes/chain-decision.md). 2026-10-01: Tempo-aware Foundry is the nightly build (foundryup --install nightly, forge 1.6.0-nightly has --tempo.fee-token); forgeArgs pay fees in pathUSD (0x20c0...0000), so the deployer needs pathUSD. 2026-10-02 testnet run: Tempo state creation costs ~4x EVM gas (deploy needs ~12.8M vs forge local sim 3.3M), so forgeArgs add --gas-estimate-multiplier 500; without it the deploy runs out of gas.

EURC.notes: No native EURC listed by Circle for this chain on 2026-09-29; do not use a bridged EURC without a human check.
